observations: Photo 0 shows a stainless steel double-door refrigerator with an LG badge on the upper right of the top door.
Photo 1 shows the empty interior with shelves, door bins, crisper drawers, and the interior light on.
Photo 2 shows a dark side/rear view with little usable detail.
All three photos carry the watermark "POSTED ON JIJI SMITH NYONG".

Photos 0 and 1 show a clean exterior and interior.
No ice production or ice maker operation is shown in any photo.

risks.proof: A video of the compressor running and the interior reaching cold temperature.

risks.risk: Ice maker or ice-making feature may not work.
risks.proof: A video of ice being produced or the dispenser operating.
risks.if_unproven: as without a working ice feature.

risks.risk: Door seals may be torn or leaking.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the door gaskets or a seal test.

risks.risk: Hidden damage on the sides or rear.
risks.proof: Well-lit photos of all sides and the rear.

proof_requests: Video of the fridge running with the door open showing cooling.
Video of the ice maker producing ice.
Close-up photos of the door seals.
Clear photos of the rear and sides.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an LG double-door fridge from photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case (not working) despite unverified performance claims.
